claim: The lazy relation-key getter for the Relations v2 adapter now reads db._?.schema instead of the db._?.relations it read before the change, so it builds relation keys from the wrong metadata field for callers using the v2 relations API.

getRelationKeysByModel uses ?? instead of ??=, so relationKeysByModel is never assigned and buildRelationKeysByModel(db._?.schema) is recomputed on every call instead of being cached once as the lazy-init refactor intends.

The lazy relation-key getter for the Relations v2 adapter reads db._?.schema instead of db._?.relations (the field the removed line used and the field this adapter's own metadata actually lives on), so it builds the relation-key map from the wrong (typically undefined) source and joins silently lose their relation keys.

relationKeysByModel is only read with ?? and never assigned (unlike the sibling relations-v2 getter, which uses ??=), so the intended memoization never happens and buildRelationKeysByModel(db._?.schema) is rebuilt from scratch on every call to getRelationKeysByModel() instead of once.
